summary: Diff implements significant parts of phone-number-based pairing UI and introduces backend state/types for phone numbers and phone verifications, plus a migration file. However, key BuildRequest items are not evidenced in the diff summary: backend 6-digit enforcement/generation details, SMS provider-agnostic sending + safe fallback behavior, explicit handling for OTP error cases, and complete i18n coverage for new UI strings (and some user-visible toasts remain hard-coded). The diff also includes several unrelated frontend changes (polling, theme/style, broad translation work) not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend generatePairingCode returns exactly 6 digits as Text and pairWithParent rejects anything not exactly 6 digits with an explicit non-success result.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated and the diff summary does not show the implementation of generatePairingCode or the validation logic in pairWithParent enforcing exactly 6 numeric digits; only frontend-side 6-digit validation is clearly shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must send OTP via provider-agnostic SMS mechanism and provide a safe fallback when provider credentials are not available, while still storing OTP for dev/test verification.
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the diff summary of any SMS-sending abstraction/config, provider selection, environment-based configuration, or fallback behavior. Only types/result variants for phone verification appear.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must create time-limited verification challenge tied to (child principal, resolved parent principal by phone) and handle incorrect OTP, expired OTP, too many attempts, unknown/unregistered phone, or child already paired with explicit result codes and corresponding UI messages.
missing_requirements.reason: While backend types include PhoneVerificationData with expires/isVerified and some result variants (#phoneVerificationExpired/#phoneVerificationFailed/#phoneVerificationSuccess), the diff summary does not show implementations for: parent resolution by phone, challenge keyed by (child,parent), attempt counting/lockout, and explicit handling for unknown/unregistered phone or too many attempts. Frontend i18n/error mapping for all these cases is also not evidenced in translations.

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend phone input enforces digits-only normalization and validates exact mask length implied by (00)000000000; user-facing validation messages exist in i18n (en + pt-BR).
missing_requirements.reason: Digits-only normalization/length limiting exists (parsePhoneNumberInput/isValidPhoneNumber), but the diff summary does not show the required new i18n keys for phone pairing/OTP validation errors and labels used by the new UI (e.g., keys referenced like parentPhoneTitle/parentPhoneErrorEmpty/etc.). The translation files shown only include profile setup phone strings, not the broader new flow keys.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend enforces uniqueness of parent phone numbers across accounts; attempting to claim an existing number fails with a clear handled error; updates replace prior value maintaining uniqueness.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo adds phoneNumber field and new result variant #phoneNumberAlreadyLinked, but the diff summary does not show the actual uniqueness index/check logic, update semantics, or the specific error returned by saveCallerUserProfile when a duplicate is attempted.

missing_requirements.requirement: All new user-visible labels, button text, help text, and error messages for phone-based pairing and OTP verification are sourced from i18n keys (en.ts and pt-BR.ts); no hard-coded Portuguese strings in React components.
missing_requirements.reason: New components call many new i18n keys (e.g., parentPhoneTitle/parentPhoneDescription/parentPhoneErrorInvalid, pairing phone/OTP messages), but the diff summary does not show those keys added to en.ts and pt-BR.ts. Additionally, user-visible toasts in useSaveCallerUserProfile are hard-coded English strings rather than i18n-sourced.

hallucinated_features.description: Added broad automatic polling/refetch behavior for multiple queries/components (children list, activities, locations, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on pairing/phone/SMS + i18n; general polling for dashboard data is not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Theme-token-based styling and various UI/translation overhauls across unrelated pages (Admin panel, Transparency policies, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; only pairing/phone-based flow and related i18n strings were requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced backend migration system (backend/migration.mo) and applied it on upgrade.
hallucinated_features.reason: Migration was allowed only if strictly necessary; the diff summary does not provide evidence it was strictly necessary, so it appears potentially extra relative to the request.
